```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```


```{r data entry}
dir <- "data/itrdb/Washington/total_ring_width/data"
datasets <- list.files(dir,recursive = TRUE,pattern='.txt',full.names = TRUE)
datasets_short <- list.files(dir,pattern=".txt",recursive=TRUE,full.names=FALSE)
```


```{r mark the outliers}

for(d in 1:length(datasets)) {
  df <- read_tsv(datasets[d],comment="#",na=c("NA"),col_types = cols(.default = col_double()))
  
  year_col <- "age_CE"
  tree_col <- setdiff(names(df),year_col)
  df_with_flag <- df
  
  
  for(tree in tree_col){
    x <- df[[tree]]
    z <- (x-mean(x,na.rm=TRUE))/sd(x,na.rm=TRUE)
    outlier_flag <- paste0(tree,"_outlier_flag")
    df_with_flag[outlier_flag]<- ifelse(is.na(z),NA,abs(z)>3)}
  
    tree_summary <- data.frame(tree=tree_col)
    all_years <- seq(min(df_with_flag[[year_col]],na.rm=TRUE),2024)
    focus_years <- seq(1980,2024)
    
  for(tree in tree_col){
    
    non_missing <- df %>%
      select(all_of(year_col),all_of(tree)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[tree]]))
    
    observed_years <- non_missing[[year_col]]
    
    missing_total <- length(setdiff(all_years,observed_years))
    missing_focus <- length(setdiff(focus_years,observed_years))
    
    outlier_col <- paste0(tree,"_outlier_flag")
    n_outliers <- sum(df_with_flag[[outlier_col]],na.rm=TRUE)
    
    tree_summary[tree_summary$tree==tree,"n_missing_total"] <- missing_total
    tree_summary[tree_summary$tree==tree,"n_missing_1980_on"] <- missing_focus
    tree_summary[tree_summary$tree==tree,"n_outliers_total"]<- n_outliers
  }
    
  write_csv(df_with_flag,paste0(substr(datasets[d],1,51),"cleaned_tree_data_with_flags.csv"))
  write_csv(tree_summary,paste0(substr(datasets[d],1,51),"tree_quality_summary.csv"))
}
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
